نغلنثي (form IIIq)
# نَغْلَنْثِي (naḡlanṯī) /naɣ.lan.θiː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِغْلَنْثَى (iḡlanṯā)
# نَغْلَنْثِيَ (naḡlanṯiya) /naɣ.lan.θi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِغْلَنْثَى (iḡlanṯā)
